title: avoid confirm password field
name: Avoid a confirm-password field — GOV.UK
rule: Do not add a second confirm-password field when the password input can be shown and hidden.
pass_when: Create/enter password uses one password field with show/hide, not a paired confirm field.
fail_when: A confirm-password (re-enter) field is required in addition to the password input.
overview: Skip a confirm-password field when users can show and hide the password.
apply_when: Creating or entering a password with a show/hide control.
not_when: Not a ban on repeating email fields, or on two distinct passwords (current vs new) on a change-password form.
agent_hint: Use one password field plus show/hide. Do not add a confirm-password input.
description: It is not necessary to add a second password field, also known as a confirm-password field, particularly when the input lets users show and hide the value. One field plus reveal is enough to check entry. Fail when a re-enter confirm field is required in addition to the password. This is not about repeating an email field, and it is not about asking for current password and new password as two different values.
do_not_claim: NN/g don't-repeat-password-email-fields (not a published primary). Repeating email. Current-vs-new on a change-password form. Password-strength meter.
